createutilities.ponder.gearcube.header: Using a six-axis gearbox to transmit rotational force
createutilities.ponder.gearcube.text_1: This method of transmitting rotational force in all directions is rather cumbersome.
createutilities.ponder.gearcube.text_2: A six-axis gearbox makes the unit even more compact
createutilities.ponder.lshaped_gearbox.h: Use L-shaped gearbox to transmit rotational force
createutilities.ponder.lshaped_gearbox.t: This way of changing direction seems quite cumbersome.
Using a gearbox will make it more compact than the previous design, but the interfaces in the other two directions are useless.
With the L-shaped gearbox, this goal can be achieved in a simpler and more economical way
Right-click it with a wrench to change the direction of its interface
createutilities.ponder.void_motor.text_1: Void motors can transmit rotational force over long distances
createutilities.ponder.void_motor.text_2: Place an item in its slot, which can be assigned a frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_motor.text_3: Right-click on the bottom slot to unclaim the Void Motor
createutilities.ponder.void_motor.text_5: If a Void Motor is claimed, only the owner can edit its frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_motor.text_6: Void motors can only transfer rotational force between void motors with the same frequency and the same owner.
createutilities.ponder.void_chest.text_1: Void boxes can deliver items over long distances
createutilities.ponder.void_chest.text_2: Place an item in its slot, which can be assigned a frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_chest.text_3: Right-click on the bottom slot to unclaim a void chest
createutilities.ponder.void_chest.text_5: If a void chest is claimed, only the owner can edit its frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_chest.text_6: Void Chests can only transfer items between Void Chests on the same frequency and with the same owner.
createutilities.ponder.void_tank.text_1: Void fluid storage tanks can transfer fluids over long distances
createutilities.ponder.void_tank.text_2: Place an item in its slot, which can be assigned a frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_tank.text_3: Right-click on the bottom slot to unclaim the Void Fluid Tank
createutilities.ponder.void_tank.text_5: If a Void Fluid Tank is claimed, only the owner can edit its frequency
createutilities.ponder.void_tank.text_6: Void Fluid Tanks can only transfer fluid between Void Fluid Tanks of the same frequency and owner.
createutilities.ponder.void_battery.head: Use void battery
createutilities.ponder.void_battery.text: Void batteries can transmit energy over long distances
Place an item in its slot, which can be assigned a frequency
Right-click on the bottom slot to unclaim the Void Battery
If a Void Battery is claimed, only the owner can edit its frequency
Void batteries can only transfer energy between void batteries with the same frequency and the same owner.
